title: Modul POS - Reports & Analytics - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap POS reporting & analytics mencakup sales report, cashier performance, product analytics, discount tracking, inventory variance, table occupancy, dan export formats.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: POS Reports & Analytics menyediakan comprehensive insights tentang sales performance, cashier efficiency, product trend, discount impact, dan inventory health. Real-time dashboard, scheduled reports, dan multiple export format support decision-making & compliance.

items.title: Real-Time KPI Dashboard

items.title: Visual Charts
items.body: Sales Trend: - Line chart: Hourly sales throughout day - Peak identification (lunch, dinner) - Compare previous day/week Product Mix: - Pie chart: Revenue by product category - Bar chart: Top 10 products by qty/revenue - Trend: Best seller, new item performance Payment Method: - Pie: Cash vs Card vs QRIS breakdown - Trend: Payment preference changes Hourly Breakdown: - Stacked bar: Transactions, revenue, discount per hour - Identify slow hours (opportunity) - Plan staffing based on traffic

items.title: Discount Tracking
items.body: Purpose: Monitor discount impact on revenue & profitability. Report: ``` DISCOUNT ANALYSIS - May 5, 2026 TOTAL DISCOUNT: Rp 450,000 DISCOUNT RATE: 8.6% of gross sales BY TYPE: • Item-level: Rp 250K (55.6%) - Specific product promo • Order-level: Rp 150K (33.3%) - Bulk/minimum purchase • Voucher: Rp 50K (11.1%) - Promo code redemption BY AMOUNT RANGE: • < Rp 25K: 42 instances (7.4K avg) • Rp 25-50K: 12 instances (35K avg) • Rp 50-100K: 5 instances (75K avg) • > Rp 100K: 1 instance (150K - required approval) BY CASHIER: Ahmad: Rp 180K discount, 8 instances (6.8% rate) Siti: Rp 125K discount, 5 instances (8.1% rate) Budi: Rp 145K discount, 7 instances (9.3% rate) MONITOR: Budi has higher discount rate - may need retraining ROI ANALYSIS: Promo: Buy Bakso get 15% off (last 3 days) • Cost: Rp 200K (discounted revenue) • Result: Bakso qty +25% vs normal • Revenue gain: Rp 300K (net positive) • ROI: +50% ✓ SUCCESS ```

Report: ``` TABLE OCCUPANCY REPORT - May 5, 2026 TABLE PERFORMANCE: Table | Pax | Turnover | Avg Time | Revenue | Profit ──────┼─────┼──────────┼──────────┼───────────┼─────────── 1 | 2 | 4.2x | 45 min | Rp 450K | Rp 270K 2 | 4 | 3.1x | 60 min | Rp 680K | Rp 408K 3 | 4 | 2.8x | 65 min | Rp 520K | Rp 312K 4 | 6 | 2.0x | 90 min | Rp 420K | Rp 252K PEAK OCCUPANCY: • Time: 11:30-13:00 (lunch rush) • Utilization: 95% (all tables occupied) • Avg wait: 15-20 min for seating • Revenue: Rp 1.8M (highest hourly) SLOW PERIOD: • Time: 14:00-17:00 (post-lunch) • Utilization: 20% (low traffic) • Opportunity: Happy hour promo AVERAGE TURN-AROUND: 62.75 min TARGET: 60 min STATUS: Slightly slow - improve efficiency ```

items.title: Export Format
items.body: Available Export Formats: 1. PDF: - Professional format - For printing & archiving - Charts included - Digital signature support 2. Excel (.xlsx): - Spreadsheet format - Multiple sheets (summary, detail, chart) - Formulas & sorting - Import ke accounting system 3. CSV (.csv): - Comma-separated values - Raw data for analysis - Import ke BI tools - Lightweight How to Export: 1. Generate report 2. Click 'Export' button 3. Select format (PDF / Excel / CSV) 4. Choose filename 5. Download 6. Save locally / send ke stakeholder

items.title: Scheduled Reports
items.body: Automated Report Generation: Admin dapat schedule report untuk otomatis generate & email. Setup: 1. Navigate: Admin > Reports > Schedule 2. Create new schedule: - Report type: Daily Sales Summary - Frequency: Daily - Time: 18:00 (end of day) - Format: PDF - Recipients: - Manager (manager@pos.com) - Finance (finance@company.com) 3. Save 4. System auto-generate & email setiap hari 18:00 Scheduled Report Options: - Daily (end of day) - Weekly (every Monday) - Monthly (1st of month) - Custom (specific dates) Benefit: - Automatic insights - Manager alerted immediately - No manual report request - Data-driven decisions

content.body: Data Export untuk BI Tools: POS data dapat export ke Excel/CSV, kemudian import ke Power BI / Looker untuk advanced analytics. Typical BI Dashboard: - Real-time sales trend - Revenue forecast - Customer segment analysis - Seasonal pattern - Profitability forecast - Staff performance vs target - Regional comparison (multi-outlet) API Available: - Query: `/api/v1/pos/reports/sales` - Format: JSON - Authentication: API key - Rate limit: 100 req/min - Use for integration dengan BI platform

Report Retention: - Keep minimum 7 years (tax regulation) - Immutable records (cannot modify historical data) - Audit trail: Who access, when, what Tax Compliance: - Daily sales summary exportable untuk tax filing - Format: Sesuai tax authority requirement (pajak) - Timestamp: ISO 8601 with timezone - Digital signature: Available for signed reports Internal Audit: - Regular review of sales pattern - Identify anomalies - Cross-check dengan payment reconciliation - Document adjustments
